title: Realistic impersonation using plausible salary and copied corporate details
description: Plausible employer details plus an unrelated contact domain create a suspected impersonation scenario; agency authorization remains unresolved.
unresolved_facts: Affiliation or authorized agency status of recruitment-desk.example has not been established
Plausible corporate details copied from public web cannot authenticate offer issuance

recruiter_assessment.summary: Sender domain '@recruitment-desk.example' does not match Infosys BPM's official domain 'infosysbpm.com'.

rationale: Copied company details do not authenticate issuance. A different contact domain warrants independent affiliation/agency confirmation, but the supplied evidence alone does not establish fraud.
